methodology: Units are counted once per community, at the count owned. 'Held' is communities Greyson owns today; 'sold' is communities Greyson bought and sold. Communities still pending confirmation are excluded until confirmed. Outdoor hospitality is not counted.
lifetimeMethodology: The lifetime total adds communities pending confirmation: UM5 (156 units, held), Woodmere Reserve (200 units, sold) and Woods at Ridgeway (568 units, a prior interest the principals raised capital for and managed).
